business_problem: Today’s workforce and workplaces are changing, and so is the technology supporting them. Avionté , which offers solutions to help staffing companies find and recruit talent, is keeping up with the changes.
solution_summary: Today’s workforce and workplaces are changing, and so is the technology supporting them. Avionté , which offers solutions to help staffing companies find and recruit talent, is keeping up with the changes. As Avionté migrated, its customers immediately experienced an improvement in the performance of Avionté’s services. “The migration to AWS has made a remarkable difference, and we are already starting to see it in our net promoter score,” says Tuttle. “The issues related to availability and performance have largely dropped off the radar altogether, and now, we’re focusing on innovation and helping customers get to the next level.” On AWS, Avionté achieved 99.999 percent availability, which wasn’t possible in its collocated data center. Its average response time for web traffic is 80 ms, and it improved its mean time to recovery.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Hosts the foundation models and generative AI application logic.

solution_components.name: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud
solution_components.role: Provides scalable compute capacity for application services or AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Amazon S3
solution_components.role: Stores documents, media, telemetry, or training data durably at scale.

solution_components.name: Amazon API Gateway
solution_components.role: Exposes application and AI services through managed APIs.

data_flow: Data is stored in Amazon S3 and processed by Amazon Bedrock.
business_outcome: As the workplace continues to change, Avionté has embraced the cloud so that it can meet the changing needs and expectations of workers and agencies. “We’re adding more capabilities for agencies, employers, and the talent that interacts with them,” says Tuttle. “The way workers interact with employers is changing, and we’re adapting our tech stack to make that more fluid.
